title: SparrowMap
excerpt: Cameras that watch government vehicles, run by volunteers, owned by nobody.
content_html:
SPARROWMAP The map is live.

Watching the watchers

Cameras that watch
government vehicles.
Owned by nobody.

Volunteers point a spare phone at a street. It reads the vehicles that go past, keeps the government ones, and destroys everything else on the device, before anything is sent anywhere.

Open the live map Add a camera Driving mode

Kept

Government vehicles

The photo and the plate are kept, and they become the public record. Public money, public roads, public vehicles.

Destroyed

Everybody else

The plate is destroyed on the camera itself, before anything leaves it. What reaches the server is an anonymous dot with no photo and no plate.

Running a camera

There is nothing to install and no account to make. It runs in a browser tab on a phone you have already stopped using, propped in a window.

The detection runs on the phone, not on a server. That matters more than it sounds: if the video were uploaded for a server to look at, there would be a video feed to intercept. There is not one.

  • Works on an old phone, a laptop webcam, or a USB camera
  • No account, no sign up, no app store
  • Your camera's exact location is never published, only the street it watches
  • You can shut it off and take your camera out of the network at any time

Want an always-on camera?

A spare PC with a webcam can run the full detector locally — it tells a patrol car from an ordinary one on the machine, and reads plates. One command sets it up and starts contributing to the map:

  • Windows: run irm https://sparrowmap.com/install-node-windows.ps1 | iex in PowerShell, or download SparrowMapCameraSetup.exe
  • Linux (help us test): curl -fsSL https://sparrowmap.com/install-node-linux.sh | bash
  • Everything still runs on your machine — only detections leave it, never video
  • Full guide: Running a desktop camera

content_html_zh:
SPARROWMAP The map is live.

看着观察者

监视政府车辆的摄像机。不属于任何人。

志愿者将备用手机指向街道。 它会读取经过的车辆，保留政府车辆，并在将任何东西发送到任何地方之前销毁设备上的其他所有内容。

打开实时地图 添加摄像头 驾驶模式

Kept

政府车辆

照片和车牌被保留下来，成为公共记录。 公共资金、公共道路、公共车辆。

被毁

其他人

在任何东西离开相机之前，该板就会在相机本身上被破坏。 到达服务器的是一个匿名点，没有照片，也没有车牌。

运行相机

无需安装任何东西，也无需创建帐户。 它在您已经停止使用的手机上的浏览器选项卡中运行，并显示在窗口中。

检测在手机上运行，​​而不是在服务器上运行。 这比听起来更重要：如果上传视频供服务器查看，就会有一个视频源可供拦截。 没有一个。

  • 适用于旧手机、笔记本电脑网络摄像头或 USB 摄像头
  • 没有帐户，没有注册，没有应用商店
  • 您的相机的确切位置永远不会公布，只会公布它所监视的街道
  • 您可以随时将其关闭并将相机从网络中删除

想要一个永远在线的相机吗？

一台带有网络摄像头的备用电脑可以在本地运行完整的探测器——它可以区分机器上的巡逻车和普通巡逻车，并读取车牌。 一个命令将其设置并开始为地图做出贡献：

  • Windows：运行 irm https://sparrowmap.com/install-node-windows.ps1 | PowerShell 中的 iex，或下载 SparrowMapCameraSetup.exe
  • Linux（帮助我们测试）：curl -fsSL https://sparrowmap.com/install-node-linux.sh |巴什
  • 一切仍然在您的机器上运行 - 只有检测离开它，而不是视频
  • 完整指南：运行桌面摄像头
